proof_body:
by
  intro α _ μ p f g hp hf hg
  exact MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_add_le hf hg hp
target_source: ∀ (α : Type*) [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) (p : ENNReal) (f g : α → ℝ), 1 ≤ p → MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f μ → MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable g μ → MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (f + g) p μ ≤ MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f p μ + MeasureTheory.eLpNorm g p μ
